method: backward Euler, direct two-species positive map; analytical exponential and integrated-throughput references are independent of this recurrence

normalization.C_scale: initial C for C>0; empty checks use exact zero branch
normalization.N_scale: max(initial N, 1e-15 mol) for accounting roundoff only, not an added inventory
normalization.amplitude: abs(c_B0-c_Beq); exclude equilibrium and empty from relative-amplitude metrics
normalization.G_ex0_scale: G_ex(0); exclude equilibrium/empty; absolute scale R*T*N remains separately reported
normalization.near_zero_metric_floor: 1e-12 of its stated dimensionless normalization; below-floor metrics export null order/relative ratio with reason, never fabricated zero or order
normalization.raw_values: All raw residuals/minima and normalizers exported alongside normalized values; normalization floors do not alter states or activities.

support: Exact windows, native grids, 401 common snapshots and common half-step union are frozen in proposed-settings.json. References are evaluated directly at each requested physical time. Native and snapshot metrics are separate, never an unlabeled maximum over differing supports.

benchmarks.name: Domain, units and detailed balance
planned_checks: All finite inputs in declared positive/zero domains; reject negative concentration, zero/nonpositive/nonfinite T,V_l,c°,lambda,K_eq. Invalid inputs emit explicit error before arithmetic, not NaN CSV rows.
Dimensions: n=Vc [mol], r=k*c [mol m^-3 s^-1], V*r*DeltaG [J s^-1], G_ex and D [J], entropy D/T [J K^-1].
Derived k_f/k_r=K_eq and DeltaG°/(RT)=-ln(K_eq). Chemical versus transformed basis and m=2 reaction-basis invariance must remain explicit.

criteria.invalid_input_rule: all declared invalid inputs rejected; no epsilon, clipping, max(0,r), logistic replacement or independent inconsistent parameter overrides

benchmarks.name: Independent reference and analytical limits
planned_checks: Derive and substitute the exponential concentrations, integrate both one-way fluxes, verify signed extent identity and positive bounds. Reference must not call the candidate step method.
Compare direct two-state G_ex expression with independent binary relative-entropy expression at the same reference states; derive minimum, derivative and convexity analytically.

At exact zero time, gross references zero; at t>0 boundary starts positive; at infinite mathematical time approach equilibrium; no finite exact depletion. Small-z analytic integrals use stable u/v evaluation.

criteria.reference_derivative_rule: independent analytical substitution, not finite-difference approximation treated as exact; record implementation formula readback and all finite-domain checks

benchmarks.name: Positive inventory and independent gross ledger
planned_checks: Evolve A and B independently with the 2x2 map. Retain both amounts; no complement substitution or mass repair.
Accumulate V*h*k_f*A_new and V*h*k_r*B_new separately. Reconstruct both amount changes using their signed difference.
Check every step including actual partial h: total residual, both independent extent residuals, cumulative gross nonnegativity and monotonicity, no overshoot.

criteria.negative_state_rule: any negative concentration or amount FAIL; core and nonempty auxiliary at t>0 strictly positive
criteria.gross_nonnegative_rule: every one-way increment and cumulative throughput nonnegative; no clipping
criteria.empty_rule: states and all amounts/throughputs exactly zero

benchmarks.name: Equilibrium, forward and reverse meaning
planned_checks: Equilibrium core remains stationary: net rate and extent vanish; gross rates equal and positive; G_ex and power vanish to roundoff.
Forward/reverse cores keep correct side of equilibrium and signed extent; positive states satisfy RT*ln(r_plus/r_minus)=-DeltaG and Q/K_eq consistency.
Do not treat balanced gross throughput as work or label the empty state Q=K_eq.

criteria.sign_rule: For finite non-equilibrium values r*DeltaG<=0 within the energy roundoff threshold in B05; near-zero values reported, not forced into an equilibrium branch.

benchmarks.name: Gibbs dissipation and zero-log domains
planned_checks: G_ex nonnegative and nonincreasing; power nonnegative at every finite-domain sample; D_state=G_ex0-G_ex and accumulated step drops agree, recognizing the telescoping identity is not independent accuracy proof.
Per step compute DeltaD_state, endpoint W_end=h*P_new and gap=DeltaD_state-W_end; convexity requires gap>=0.

No comparison with heat; no captured ATP/work. At initial B=0,A>0 keep Q=0 and null ΔG/P with zero_B_activity; at A=0,B>0 Q/ΔG/P null with zero_A_activity. Finite G_ex at both boundaries. Empty has Q/ΔG/P null and G_ex=D=0. All nonempty t>0 values finite.

criteria.null_rules: exact nullable-field/status/reason consistency; no NaN/Infinity serialized; no epsilon or numerical zero masquerading as an undefined log
criteria.no_accuracy_claim: Allowed roundoff is reported raw, never repaired; gap and endpoint proxy are diagnostics, not asserted equal to true continuous dissipation.

benchmarks.name: Candidate accuracy against analytical references
planned_checks: For each nonempty core, compare both concentrations, G_ex, signed extent and both cumulative gross throughputs at all native endpoints and separately the 401 snapshots.
Recompute nonlinear thermodynamics from interpolated snapshot states; evaluate independent reference at the same times. No linearly interpolated G_ex presented as G_ex of a state.
Equilibrium uses absolute roundoff gates, not division by zero initial deviation/energy.

criteria.scope: Each listed metric passes on each stated support for forward and reverse; equilibrium passes B03-B05 roundoff rules. Accuracy in a nearly depleted energy tail is absolute, not an unsupported small-G_ex relative guarantee. No production accuracy gate on h/tau=10 auxiliaries.

benchmarks.name: Common-support refinement and actual default history
planned_checks: On the frozen union support compare candidate and half-step solutions for both concentrations, G_ex and all three extents; never compare unequal-time array indices.

For non-equilibrium forward/reverse, compute direct-reference normalized max concentration errors for 100,50,25 s and p=log2(E_h/E_h2) on the same 401 snapshots and separately a fixed union of all three native grids plus these snapshots. If candidate must be finer, use its last three consecutive sizes and their fixed union instead; pin exact sizes. Native-endpoint-only maxima remain direct accuracy checks, not unequal-support order evidence.
Preserve every attempted candidate, run order, actual gate failure, supporting metrics, step/window/support identity and reason. No engineered fake fail or presumed coarse failure.

criteria.order_floor_rule: Only use errors above 1e-12; equilibrium order null, not 1. If informative core concentration orders cannot be resolved, default gate unresolved/FAIL, never automatically waived. Report G_ex/throughput refinement errors without asserting the same order threshold for cancellation-dominated diagnostics.
criteria.default_rule: All B01-B08 plus B06 and its half-step B07 must pass before proposing a default; EIC independently accepts it. Apply exact bounded candidate policy in proposed-settings.json.

benchmarks.name: Auxiliary steps, partial endpoint and export reconstruction
planned_checks: A-only and B-only have two complete h/tau=10 steps in fixed 20*tau window. Report nominal and actual h/tau; no shortened-step substitute for this test.

Empty case uses the same window. Partial-final-step case reaches its exact declared endpoint with actual h recorded. Compare auxiliary analytical values for information but do not promote coarse accuracy.

Saved CSV arithmetic reconstructs n=V*c, both inventories, independent increment ledger, G_ex0-G_ex, power units, endpoint proxy and numerical gap using only declared inputs/columns; reconstruct common snapshots/refinement support and null rules.

criteria.partial_final_endpoint_rule: last actual h positive and no greater than nominal h; exact target endpoint represented in metadata; no overshoot or silent extension
criteria.csv_json_numeric_precision: 17 significant digits; empty CSV cell/null JSON for undefined values with reason; mathematical zero is numeric 0
criteria.schema_rule: Required files, IDs, units, synthetic labels, headers, candidate history and reference/method/sample-support provenance present; this is not empirical or learner validation.

change_control: Reviewer critique before implementation; EIC acceptance and implementation authority separate. Any changed equations, cases, supports, tolerance or export meaning require an explicit affected contract delta.
